title: 第5章 超出百相外第6章 爷爷方志远
content_zh:
;;
这些能清晰呈现方羽生命层次、武道技艺、灵魂等级的讯息，并非一些小说中一证永恒的‘系统面板’。
它，更像是沉睡星相洞察方羽的身体灵魂后，所传递出的讯息。
如同一尊精密的生命检测仪，让方羽能随时知晓自身情况。
并无其他直接帮助。
“也不知，到底要我生命层次达到什么地步，才能彻底看清这尊虚空星相。”方羽若有所思。
虚空星相，是百余年来，星空武道蓬勃发展，乃至武道通神的源头。
按方羽从小学习的武道通识课中所记载。
大焚天时代前。
古武术中，一些不可思议的大宗师，武道技艺早已超越内景，达到‘秋风未动蝉先觉’之境，如此技艺，令他们能锁住浑身气血上脑洗髓、颠倒乾坤，使自身寿命轻松达200岁。
可是。
这些大宗师的拳力，最多也只有两三千公斤，也就和这个时代的中级武者比一比。
为何？
所缺少的，便是虚空星相。
“按科学研究，武道通识课上所言，宇宙星河中，有着一种神秘能量‘星力’，我们人类难以靠自身吸收的。”方羽暗道：“唯有生命层次达到10级，且觉醒‘虚空星相’后，观想星相，以星相照映身体百星，继而打开星窍，才能逐渐吸收宇宙中的星力。”
“这，便是星力入体。”
星力融入全身每一个细胞，会全方位推动身体进化，骨骼强度、骨膜韧性、细胞活力、肌肉爆发力、皮肤坚韧程度等等都会持续飙升，不断打破生命极限。
甚至令基因本质都在不断蜕变。
这，便是大焚天时代后的一百多年里，人类生命进化飞速发生的原因。
直至数十年前，诞生出肉身硬扛核弹的生命体——星空武者！

“论武道技艺，巡天武者都未必赶得上数千年古武历史上诞生的一些大宗师。”方羽暗自感慨：“可是，那些大宗师，碰到普通枪械，都得殒命。”
可巡天武者，是能够以超音速飞行的，甚至短暂进入外太空生活。
两种，已不是同一物种。
区别，就在于虚空星相。
“若我没有虚空星相，或是觉醒下位星相。”方羽默默思索着：“那么，也就不多奢求武道之路了。”
蓝月联盟，并非所有人都能观想到虚空星相。
有相当一部分人，是没有‘虚空星相’的。
哪怕能观想到，大部分人的虚空星相也极普通，无法提供太多帮助，所照映出的‘星窍’往往也很弱，吸收星力效率极低。
武者修炼，年龄很重要。
若不能在30岁的白银年龄段结束前，武道修为达到较高层次，再往后，武道前途只会越来越黯淡。
这也是武者相对较少的缘故。
无论是家长还是自身，都要考虑‘投资比’。
哪怕国家有大量扶持，正常情况下，一个学生想考上武道大专，投入数十万星币是常态的，若想考上武道本科，投入只会更多。
若最终连15级都达不到，又没学习其他文化专业，找不到好工作，只会血本无归。
所以。
许多家长，一旦发现孩子初中高中没展现太高天赋，便会放弃孩子走武道之路，只要求能达到10级拿到‘父母证’即可。
“可偏偏，我能观想到虚空星相。”方羽暗道。
只是，方羽的虚空星相不仅一直沉睡。
在方羽观想中，星相还极度模糊……多年来，随他生命层次不断提升，星相才逐渐变得清晰起来，不久前才能见到全貌。
content_en:
;;
These messages that can clearly present Fang Yu's life level, martial arts skills, and soul level are not the eternal "system panels" in some novels.
It is more like the message conveyed by the sleeping astrology after gaining insight into Fang Yu's body and soul.
Like a sophisticated life detector, Fang Yu can know his own situation at any time.
There is no other direct help.
"I don't know how far my life level needs to be before I can fully see this void star." Fang Yu thought thoughtfully.
The starry sky is the source of the vigorous development of starry sky martial arts for more than a hundred years, and even the source of martial arts and spirituality.
According to the records in the martial arts general knowledge course that Fang Yu studied since childhood.
Before the era of Great Burning Heaven.
In ancient martial arts, some incredible masters' martial arts skills have already surpassed the inner scene and reached the state of "the cicada awakens before the autumn wind blows". Such skills allow them to lock the energy and blood in the whole body, brainwash the marrow, turn the world upside down, and make their life span easily reach 200 years.
But.
The punch power of these great masters is only two to three thousand kilograms at most, which is comparable to the intermediate warriors of this era.
Why?
What is missing is the stars in the void.
"According to scientific research and what was said in the martial arts general course, there is a mysterious energy 'star power' in the universe and galaxies, which we humans are difficult to absorb on our own." Fang Yu secretly said: "Only when the life level reaches level 10 and after awakening the 'Void Star Aspect', one can visualize the stars, use the stars to illuminate the hundreds of stars in the body, and then open the star orifices, in order to gradually absorb the star power in the universe."
"This is the star power entering the body."
Star power is integrated into every cell in the body, which will promote body evolution in all aspects. Bone strength, periosteum toughness, cell vitality, muscle explosive power, skin toughness, etc. will continue to soar, constantly breaking the limits of life.
Even the genetic essence is constantly changing.
This is the reason why human life has evolved rapidly in the more than a hundred years since the Great Burning Era.
Until a few decades ago, a life form with the physical body to carry a nuclear bomb was born - the Star Warrior!
"In terms of martial arts skills, the warriors who patrol the sky may not be able to match some of the great masters born in the thousands of years of ancient martial arts history." Fang Yu secretly sighed: "However, those great masters will die if they encounter ordinary firearms."
The Space Patrol Warrior can fly at supersonic speeds and even briefly enter outer space.
The two species are no longer the same species.
The difference lies in the void stars.
"If I don't have the void star, or awaken the lower star." Fang Yu thought silently: "Then, I won't have the extravagant pursuit of martial arts."
In the Blue Moon Alliance, not everyone can visualize the void stars.
There are quite a few people who do not have the ‘Void Star Aspect’.
Even if they can visualize it, most people's void stars are very ordinary and cannot provide much help. The 'star aperture' they reflect is often very weak, and the efficiency of absorbing star power is extremely low.
When cultivating a warrior, age is very important.
If one cannot reach a higher level of martial arts cultivation before the end of the 30-year-old silver age, the future of martial arts will only become increasingly bleak.
This is also the reason why there are relatively few warriors.
Both parents and themselves must consider the ‘investment ratio’.
Even if the country provides a lot of support, under normal circumstances, if a student wants to be admitted to a martial arts college, it is normal to invest hundreds of thousands of star coins. If he wants to be admitted to a martial arts undergraduate degree, the investment will only be even more.
If you can't even reach level 15 in the end, and you haven't studied other cultural majors, you can't find a good job, and you will lose everything.
so.
Many parents, once they discover that their children have not shown much talent in junior high and high school, will give up on their children's path to martial arts and only require that their children reach level 10 and obtain a 'parent certificate'.
"But unfortunately, I can visualize the stars in the sky." Fang Yu said secretly.
However, Fang Yu's Void Star has not only been sleeping.
In Fang Yu's visualization, the stars were still extremely vague... Over the years, his life levels have changed.As the stars continue to improve, the stars gradually become clearer, and not long ago we were able to see the full picture.
